title: BatchPublishRequest
description: Body of POST /articles:batch: a single 'articles' array. Each item is the article payload defined by article.schema.json plus a required per-item idempotency_key, since one HTTP header cannot carry N keys. The article shape itself is owned by article.schema.json and is unchanged; the fields are mirrored here only so a batch payload validates as one document. The server strict-decodes each item (unknown fields rejected) exactly like the single payload, validates every item before any write, and commits the whole batch in one transaction or none of it.

articles.description: The articles to publish. An empty array is accepted and writes nothing.

title.description: Headline. maxLength is input hygiene, not a content limit.

body.description: Article body as Markdown. No maximum length; bodies must never be truncated.

slug.description: Optional; derived from the title when absent. Must be unique within the batch.

published_at.description: Optional; defaults to the server receipt time.

metadata.description: Open-ended attributes, including the media keys (image, image_alt, youtube).

idempotency_key.description: Per-item idempotency key; must be unique within the batch. A replayed key returns the prior article with status deduplicated.
